limitations: Exact-source preparation only; full renderer compilation and installed acceptance remain separate.
Joins returned copy/directory/stat/removal promises and the walker promise; no guarantee for hidden native work or a walker that never reports completion.
A synchronous nonthrowing walker callback retains its own serial batch chain; first failure stops subsequent copy/fallback/progress starts and prevents source cleanup.
UserCanceled now rejects after joined work rather than replacing the copy chain or continuing source cleanup.
No physical path ownership, no-clobber transfer, rollback, cancellation/termination permit or native installation authority.

walkerSource.testBinding: Exact JavaScript wrapper; native WalkDir is an owned event facade, not native execution.
